sources.title: Activity-dependent scaling of quantal amplitude in neocortical neurons
sources.inspected: Publisher abstract and figure descriptions; full text was subscription-restricted.
sources.finding_used: Activity-dependent regulation of aggregate synaptic strength in cortical cultures motivates investigating activity stability.
sources.limit: No biological firing target, time conversion, human ageing law or optimizer schedule is imported into the model.

sources.title: The remarkable robustness of surrogate gradient learning for instilling complex function in spiking neural networks
sources.inspected: Author summary and indexed paper excerpts; direct publisher and bioRxiv full-text opens returned 403.
sources.finding_used: The authors report different sensitivity to surrogate shape and scale, including experiments with sparse-activity regularization.
sources.limit: The complete paper, numerical method and experiments were not replicated. No new surrogate formula is introduced here.

engineering_decision: Measure actual early source-update coordinates, clipping and neuron response scale at fixed depth and hidden/channel ratio. Test the existing core-rate multiplier from random initialization before changing the neuron equations.
